events.description: 24. ORDER re Injunction Hearing. The hearing scheduled for 10/7/2024 at 9:30 a.m. will proceed as scheduled. The Court intends to allocate a total of four hours to be split evenly between each side. Each side may use their time for witness testimony or attorney argument.
